arxiv-2109-08215.creator: Zi Wang wangzi@google.com, George E. Dahl gdahl@google.com, Kevin Swersky kswersky@google.com, Chansoo Lee chansoo@google.com, Zachary Nado znado@google.com, Justin Gilmer gilmer@google.com, Jasper Snoek jsnoek@google.com, Zoubin Ghahramani zoubin@google.com
arxiv-2109-08215.description: Abstract Bayesian optimization (BO) has become a popular strategy for global optimization of expensive real-world functions. Such domain knowledge often manifests in Gaussian process (GP) priors that specify initial beliefs on functions.

pmc-11516342.creator: H Barros
pmc-11516342.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundPostpartum depression (PPD) affects about 17% of healthy mothers within one year of childbirth. The etiology remains unknown, but PPD is influenced by a combination of genetic, physical, psychosocial, and obstetric factors, migration could influence the risk.MethodsWe analyzed data collected within the scope of baMBINO (Perinatal Health in Migrants: Barriers, Incentives, and Outcomes), a Portuguese prospective cohort study, aimed to investigate the maternity experiences and outcomes of migrant women, defined as foreign-born women, and compared to native women.

The primary outcome was a composite of adverse outcomes, including perinatal death and neonatal morbidity.

pmc-12590048.title: A Diagnostic Puzzle: Unveiling Tuberculosis Peritonitis in an Immunocompromised Patient
pmc-12590048.creator: André Pereira, Inês Peixoto, Ana Silva, Rosa Cardoso, Helena Sarmento
pmc-12590048.description: Tuberculosis (TB) remains a leading cause of infectious morbidity and mortality worldwide. Extrapulmonary TB, particularly abdominal TB, is a diagnostic challenge due to its nonspecific presentation and often low sensitivity for conventional tests. Immunocompromised patients, such as those with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), are at increased risk and may lack classic systemic symptoms, preventing timely diagnosis.

pmc-12594945.title: Prevalence and health checkup-based detection of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease in Japanese young adults
pmc-12594945.creator: Satoko Tajirika, Takao Miwa, Tatsunori Hanai, Masahito Shimizu, Mayumi Yamamoto
pmc-12594945.description: We aimed to elucidate the prevalence of steatotic liver disease (SLD) in Japanese young adults and to identify health checkup-based markers for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). We recruited participants (18–29 years) attending a health checkup. Abdominal ultrasonography and health checkup data were used to diagnose and classify SLD.

pmc-12632027.title: Cardiometabolic risk reduction with digital twinning in patients with type 2 diabetes
pmc-12632027.creator: Seyed Arsalan Seyedi, Juan P. González-Rivas, Pranav Mellacheruvu, Ananya Mellacheruvu, Seyed Pedram Aledavood, Alireza Esteghamati, Jeffrey I. Mechanick
pmc-12632027.description: Digital twin (DT) technology—real-time, data-driven virtual models of individuals—offers transformative potential in managing cardiometabolic-based chronic disease (CMBCD). The novel CMBCD model configures a progression from interacting adiposity, dysglycemia, hypertension, dyslipidemia, and residual drivers to certain cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) such as atherosclerosis, heart failure, and atrial fibrillation.

pmc-12661838.title: Reprogramming autoimmunity: inducing antigen-specific tolerance via apoptotic mimicry in an experimental model of multiple sclerosis
pmc-12661838.creator: Herena Eixarch, Imane Boutitah-Benyaich, Jorge Plaza, Sílvia Rodríguez-Vidal, Míriam Salvadó, Montserrat Mancera-Arteu, Lidia Almenara-Fuentes, Martí Dalmases, Marta Vives-Pi, Xavier Montalban, Bruna Barneda-Zahonero, Carmen Espejo
pmc-12661838.description: BackgroundMultiple sclerosis (MS) is an immune-mediated disorder characterized by demyelination, axonal damage, and neurodegeneration, leading to neurological disability in patients. It is considered a prototypic antigen-specific autoimmune disease, and therefore is a strong candidate for therapies aimed at restoring immune tolerance to self-antigens. However, the development of effective antigen-specific tolerization remains an important unmet medical need.

pmc-13588291.description: BackgroundPediatric obesity is a major public health challenge with adverse effects on health and long-term metabolic outcomes. Protein palmitoylation is linked to lipid metabolism, but whether palmitoylation-related programs differ between pediatric and adult obesity remains unclear.
